title: The embargoes against al-Andalus spread: at the Angevins' direction, Ireland embargoes the merchants of al-Andalus

data.trend: continues the embargoes begun by Genoa in 1440

source: Trent's account (5 June 1444); the save of 27 August 1444 dates the embargo 27 May

title: The Emperor announces the commission of a new palace by the sea for the realm

data.building: grand palace (grand_palace) at Ishbīliya, standing by 1 February 1447 (autosave)

source: Trent's account, 10 October 1444; the palace stands at Ishbīliya in the autosave of 1 February 1447

title: Fārūq, second son of Prince Yūsuf and Amie of Mālī, is born at Niani
